name: Bit Size
description: A measure of surface irregularity, such as of the borehole wall. PropertyType: rugosity UnitQuantity: length; Dimension: L; PropertyTypeID: ea947ae3-ea41-4d3b-b89d-525e6854af93

name: Bulk Density
description: Density of bulk material, including any void space or other materials contained in the subject volume. In well logging, it is the density of the rock, including fluid-filled pore space, as measured with a "Gamma-Gamma" type logging device. PropertyType: bulk density UnitQuantity: mass per volume; Dimension: M/L3; PropertyTypeID: 8cf38da3-e98e-4134-a186-1c6f562d6430

name: Bulk Density Correction
description: Correction to the Bulk Density log, as measured with a Gamma-gamma type logging device; used as an indication of hole condition to validate the Bulk_Density measurement; conventionally abbreviated DRHO. PropertyType: bulk density correction UnitQuantity: mass per volume; Dimension: M/L3; PropertyTypeID: 7eb08010-79b8-4466-8f1c-a3f2ed7de3d4

name: Caliper
description: Borehole diameter as measured by a logging device: a record of the borehole or the internal diameter of tubular goods. PropertyType: caliper UnitQuantity: length; Dimension: L; PropertyTypeID: a6489707-abc0-4b1f-bb6c-ad2db135d8f7

name: Compressional Slowness
description: The time it takes for a compressional wave to traverse a fixed distance; reciprocal of Compressional_Velocity. PropertyType: compressional slowness UnitQuantity: time per length; Dimension: T/L; PropertyTypeID: 18cb5dce-cc1b-4f51-8702-e18d9f2e1ce2

name: Gamma Ray
description: The intensity of natural gamma-ray radiation emitted from formations containing radioactive elements, such as Potassium, Thorium, and Uranium. Measured according to API specifications. PropertyType: gamma ray UnitQuantity: API gamma ray; Dimension: none; PropertyTypeID: 26c54ec7-76a0-4fae-966a-c3bae13c81e0

name: Measured Depth
description: Depth measured along the borehole path from the working datum. PropertyType: measured depth UnitQuantity: length; Dimension: L; PropertyTypeID: c48c65d4-9680-4d10-903c-a1b2e30f66b5

name: Neutron Porosity
description: Porosity as measured with an neutron logging device. PropertyType: neutron porosity UnitQuantity: dimensionless; Dimension: 1; PropertyTypeID: 85a39e16-0290-40ca-899d-dd20fed44b64

name: Photoelectric Factor
description: A measure of the probability that scattering due the Photoelectric Effect will occur; often expressed in an approximation unit barns/electron. PropertyType: photoelectric factor UnitQuantity: dimensionless; Dimension: 1; PropertyTypeID: f87263cb-ac9d-4eb3-abc4-798f667c246c

name: Resistivity - Deep
description: The property of a material which resists the flow of electrical current. The ratio of electric-field intensity to current density. The reciprocal of conductivity. PropertyType: resistivity UnitQuantity: electrical resistivity; Dimension: L3M/I2T3; PropertyTypeID: 7c0d1a5d-483e-4d77-81f3-9883527838d2

name: Shear Slowness
description: Acoustic slowness of a shear wave (Vs); reciprocal of Shear_Velocity; a shear wave is a type of seismic wave in which the particle motion is perpendicular to the direction of propagation; also called S-wave or secondary wave. PropertyType: shear slowness UnitQuantity: time per length; Dimension: T/L; PropertyTypeID: a43ca4b8-61a4-4596-8575-afcd1b81edbe
